title: cleistopholis gracilipes
intro: Cleistopholis gracilipes, commonly known as the African Starfruit, is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cleistopholis gracilipes include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
